newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks steady after soft start.
newsitem.headline: French stocks steady after soft start.

text.p: French shares found support just above the 2,700 level after opening below Friday's record close.
Traders said the market was supported by the Dow's 56-point rise last Friday to close above 7,000. Bullish brokers expect the U.S. markets to continue climbing, which should boost Paris.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 1.24 points or 0.05 percent at 2,709.52 at 0925 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was flat at 2,717 from Friday's close.
"The market is consolidating. Wall Street was in good form last Friday," one broker said.
* Canal Plus rises strongly, up 3.35 percent to 1,110, on market rumours the broadcaster is in talks with the Spanish government and Telefonica for a single digital television platform.
* Pathe adds 5.29 percent to 1,493 francs, on newspaper reports it could sell its BSkyB stake, worth around 1.8 billion stg.
* Bollore Technologies jumps 7.66 percent to 759 francs on newspaper reports the privately-held Rivaud group is poised to cancel double voting rights it holds in group companies, including Bollore.
* Promodes PMD.PA, up 3.74 percent at 1,970, continues last week's gains, after 1996 results which pleased enormously.
* Societe Generale gains 1.44 percent to 705 francs ahead of 1996 results due on Wednesday. One big French broker is expecting net earnings of 4.6 billion francs.
* CCF gains 3.13 percent, joining in the rise in banking stocks, currently in favour with the stock market.
* Eridania Beghin Say sheds three percent to 970 francs. The fall could be due to profit-taking as the stock has risen strongly recently, one broker said.
* Valeo adds 1.58 percent to 380, considered as a catch-up on last week's laggard performance.
* Schneider also seen making up for recent market underperformance.
